subject: Expression of interest, graduate civil designer, Melbourne, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am sending an expression of interest for civil design or junior civil engineering work in Melbourne, as invited on your EOI page for civil designers and civil engineers.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as field engineer and project-in-charge.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for office, site and regional work.

Your EOI for emerging civil designers with 2D and 3D design capability is the path I am seeking. I do not yet have Australian consulting design-office employment, so I am looking for mentoring on practical civil design.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

paragraphs: I am writing in response to your Expressions of Interest page for civil designers, civil engineers and structural engineers, with Melbourne as my preferred location. The page asks for a CV and a short introduction.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language. Coursework covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design and documentation in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, Australian Standards and Austroads guides, and Before You Dig Australia enquiries. In 2019 I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings, and carried out inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials and prepared site, material and progress reports.

I have no Australian consulting design-office employment yet. I am based in Melton, Victoria, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for office, site and regional work.

I am seeking a junior civil design or graduate civil role where I can build 2D and 3D design skill under mentoring. My resume is attached and drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.
